title: Submission, Delivery and Posting of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Orders
content:
Payments operations rule for Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay. The delivery time, posting time, daily cutoff, weekend processing, automatic re-sends and their interval, token digits, data validity and Paloma Rewards earning that it reads are the product's own settings.

## Rules

**R1 — Top-ups, data bundles and tokens.** A Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle or Paloma Electricity Token order is submitted at once — every day when the product is processed on weekends and holidays — and is due within the product's delivery time in minutes.

**R2 — Bill payments.** A Paloma Bill Pay Utilities, Paloma Bill Pay Television or Paloma Bill Pay School Fees payment is submitted on the business day it is ordered when it is ordered by the product's submission cutoff (US Central time), and otherwise on the next business day. It posts within the product's posting time in Paloma business days.

**R3 — Rejections.** A technical rejection is re-sent automatically up to the product's number of automatic re-sends, the product's interval in minutes apart. Any other rejection — an invalid number, an account not found, an amount out of range — fails the order at once, and the order value comes back in full.

**R4 — Tokens.** A delivered electricity token is sent to the customer by SMS and by email, with the product's number of token digits.

**R5 — Data bundles.** A delivered data bundle is usable for the product's data validity period in days.

**R6 — Rewards.** Delivered orders earn Paloma Rewards points when the product is eligible for Paloma Rewards, under the Paloma Rewards terms.

## Order status through delivery

| Event | Status moves | Shown on the order's ledger |
|---|---|---|
| Payment collected, destination validated, order sent to the operator or biller | submitted to processing | the order value sent to the operator or biller (attempt 1) |
| Operator confirms the top-up or token, or biller confirms the payment posted | processing to delivered | the moment of confirmation; the token code for an electricity token |
| Operator or biller rejects the order after any automatic re-sends | processing to failed | the order value coming back in full, with the reason for the rejection |

## Cases (hypothetical times and settings)

**Before and after the cutoff.** Take a bill product whose submission cutoff is 14:00 US Central. A payment ordered at 13:20 US Central on a business day is submitted that business day. A payment ordered at 15:05 US Central on a business day is submitted on the next business day.

**Technical rejection.** Take a product with 2 automatic re-sends, 10 minutes apart. An order rejected for a technical reason is re-sent automatically up to 2 times, 10 minutes apart; if the operator still rejects it after those re-sends, the order fails and its value comes back in full.

**Invalid number.** An order rejected because the number is invalid is not re-sent automatically: it fails at once and its value comes back in full.
